interface.title: Cloud2Grid Explorer (Streamlit)
interface.field: Power systems / renewable energy integration; satellite remote sensing; machine-learning surrogates for AC power flow
interface.stage_of_work: Communicating and inspecting published results: a read-only explorer of precomputed, frozen evaluation outputs
interface.what_it_is_for: Following a real cloud-clearing event from Meteosat imagery, through satellite-derived PV output and AC power-flow states on the reconstructed Sundon distribution network, to compare five GENCO grid foundation model checkpoints (off-the-shelf through response-aware) against the AC physics reference.
interface.note: This Streamlit app is the legacy explorer, as its own banner says. The official application is the website (hinox13.github.io/grid2cloud), which this run did not visit.

data.note: Everything is precomputed and bundled: Meteosat E-View frames, LSA SAF irradiance converted to PV with pvlib, AC states, frozen GENCO predictions and Elexon APX prices. There are three hero events: 15 Jun 2024 cloud clearing, 15 Apr 2024 broken cumulus and 23 Aug 2024 clear-sky control. Summary metrics cover 2,829 real half-hourly 2024 states. Nothing was uploaded and nothing was downloaded.

tree.general: Judge whether an AI surrogate model reproduces how a physical system responds to a real, observed environmental change
tree.specific: Find out whether GENCO, a grid foundation model trained only on synthetic grids, predicts how the Sundon network's grid import responds when real clouds clear, compared with the AC power-flow reference

features.name: Time-scrubbed linked event viewer
features.general: Scrub a time slider, or let it auto-play, and watch an observation image, the derived quantities, a simulated system state and a model prediction all update to the same moment, with a cursor on a stacked time-series chart
features.specific: In Demo, the Time (UTC) slider with Play/Pause drives the Meteosat E-View frame, the four provenance cards (Real clouds, Solar power, Power grid, GENCO), the Sundon network schematic and the timeline cursor across PV, grid import and import error. Grid states are held between half-hours and labelled 'held since'.
steps: Choose an event from the dropdown
Drag the time slider or press the arrow keys to step 15 minutes
Press Play to auto-advance and Pause to stop
Read the cards and the timeline cursor at that moment
serves_tasks: Step through time and watch the observation, the derived input and the system response together
Repeat the walkthrough for contrasting events, including a control case where the driver does not change, to see how the model and the reference behave in each

features.name: Model-vs-reference network schematic with error colouring
features.general: Draw a network diagram whose edges are coloured either by a state quantity or by the difference between a chosen model and a reference, and hover any edge or node for its values
features.specific: In the Sundon 132/33/11 kV schematic, the Grid shown segmented control selects AC or one of five GENCO checkpoints. Branch colour switches between Loading (0–100%) and Error vs AC (ΔP MW, blue = model lower, red = higher). Hovering shows per-branch model P, AC P, error and loading, and per-node Vm and injection. A footer gives max loading for AC vs the model and the power-balance error.
steps: Pick the model to display
Switch the colouring between Loading and Error vs AC
Hover a branch or node to read model vs reference values
Read the summary line (max loading, power-balance error)
serves_tasks: Show one model's predicted network state and compare it with the reference, element by element

features.name: Guided multi-scene tour
features.general: Walk through a fixed sequence of annotated scenes that drive the same interactive views, with Back, Next, Replay, Exit and auto-play
features.specific: 'Take the guided tour' runs 6 scenes (with sub-scenes 4a and 4b) that set the time and model on the Demo page and show a caption with numbers. It ends with a link to the PV response page.
steps: Press Take the guided tour
Press Next or Back between scenes (or turn on Auto-play)
Replay a scene if needed
Press Exit to keep exploring freely from the final state
serves_tasks: Follow a scripted walkthrough of the event

Compare the scatter panels against the dotted reference line

screens_never_reached: Cloud Impact stage '3 · Grid' was not opened on its own (I saw 1, 2, 4 and 5).
Guided-tour Auto-play mode and 'Replay this scene' were seen but not turned on or pressed.
The Cloud Impact 'Sources, methods and limitations' expander was not opened.
External links (the official website hinox13.github.io/grid2cloud, GitHub source, frozen models, licence URLs) point outside 127.0.0.1:8501, so I did not follow them.
not_done: Clicking a point on the Demo timeline chart does not move the time slider. Time is set only by the slider, Play or the arrow keys.

When I switched the Hero event from April to August, the views fell out of sync: the slider label kept 12:15 from the previous event, while the satellite frame showed 10:45 and the timeline cursor sat at the far left (screens/038.webp, screens/039.webp).

On the Grid shown control, clicking the already-selected model pill deselects it and falls back to the AC reference, with the GENCO card reading 'select a model' (screens/016.webp). This is not obvious behaviour.
The app is read-only and precomputed. You cannot run power flow, GENCO inference or a re-fit, upload data, or export or download results, so nothing was downloaded.
The network schematic is not a geographic map ('schematic, not a map'). You can inspect topology, loads and assets only by hovering the schematic; there is no separate asset table.
According to the README, the second-network (Aylesbury East) replication page exists only on the official website, not in this legacy Streamlit app, so it could not be explored here.
